cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Enter on My Side
cards.instruction: Recruit them into your side of a contest or bargain before the stakes become fully clear.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. Back my stall at the fete. Sign here above 'joint entrant.' Please.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: What's the penalty clause below it?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. The sort of challenge best discussed between partners.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly why I've left a convenient space for your name.
